help.stdout:
usage: gnd recovery verify [-h] [--model MODEL]
                           [--verbalization VERBALIZATION]
                           ROOT REPORT

Verify REPORT beneath authoritative ROOT, together with its explicit canonical
sibling model and full verbalization. All leaves are no-follow regular files;
the runtime reloads the model, reproduces the complete verbalization, resolves
every evidence locator, and re-inventories the selected roots. Exits 3 for
malformed/stale evidence, 66 for a missing artifact, and 74 for
unsafe/unreadable paths or I/O.

positional arguments:
  ROOT                  authoritative existing recovery bundle/repository root
  REPORT                explicit canonical model.recovery.json beneath ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         explicit recovered model sibling (default:
                        model.orm.yaml)
  --verbalization VERBALIZATION
                        explicit full verbalization sibling (default:
                        model.verbalization.txt)

unknown_flag.stderr:
usage: gnd recovery verify [-h] [--model MODEL]
                           [--verbalization VERBALIZATION]
                           ROOT REPORT
gnd recovery verify: error: the following arguments are required: ROOT, REPORT
